meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: Claude 会用 Python 的 cobrapy 库处理代谢模型：加载 SBML 文件、运行通量平衡分析、模拟基因敲除、采样通量，并输出生长速率等数值结果。
howto.when: 当你想加载/构建代谢模型、运行 FBA/FVA 或通量采样、进行基因敲除分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 SBML 模型跑一遍 FBA，算出生长速率。
say.note: 用 cobrapy 的 optimize 给出结果。

say.text: 对这个大肠杆菌模型做单基因敲除筛选，找出必需基因。
计算这个模型的最小培养基。
say.note: 用 minimal_medium 算出最少组分。

howto.what_en: Claude will use the Python cobrapy library to work with metabolic models: load SBML files, run flux balance analysis, simulate gene knockouts, sample fluxes, and report numerical results such as growth rates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to load/build a metabolic model, run FBA/FVA or flux sampling, or perform gene-knockout analysis.

say_en.text: Run FBA on this SBML model and tell me the growth rate.
say_en.note: Uses cobrapy optimize to report the result.

say_en.text: Do a single-gene knockout screen on this E. coli model and find essential genes.
say_en.note: Runs single_gene_deletion and lists genes with growth below threshold.

say_en.text: Compute the minimal medium for this model.
say_en.note: Uses minimal_medium to find the fewest components.
